resource_scope: Fresh collector process has exactly one runner child. RUSAGE_CHILDREN contains waited descendant usage propagated by child reaping. ru_maxrss is the maximum single descendant process, not concurrent tree memory. inblock/oublock are raw kernel block-operation counts, not bytes. No complete per-process CPU/I/O sample or device-throughput claim.

browser_observation.coverage: Sampled runner-descendant Chromium root processes, excluding --type subprocesses. Unique PID/start_ticks observations are a lower bound on browser launches; roots shorter than the sample interval, between scans, or reparented before observation can be missed.
